capabilities.name: Camera direction, phase 2: every shot simulated and self-corrected (incl. occluded)
capabilities.required: Every directed shot is simulated sample by sample against the take (people and parts per tick, the sun, the motion caps) for collision, squeeze (stuck between plywood), foreground (behind a head), flare, subject leaving frame, horizon, motion and occlusion of the subject by non-subjects (planner readability < 0.6); failures are fixed by an explicit ladder (raise → widen → swing → re-route → shorten → split → cut), one knob per correction with the searched start heading kept, each recorded with failure, samples, strategy, before/after and reason; nothing works → refused with every strategy listed. The take sampler classifies entities by kind (piles are boxes, removed entities leave at their removal tick).
capabilities.approximate: Ladders are fixed and the first candidate valid on every sample wins — not an optimiser (the flagship orbit needed raise +2.5 m after +0.5/+1/+1.5 m stayed occluded). Thresholds (squeeze 1.2 m wide / 1.0 m high / 0.3 m from a part for ≥ 0.3 m or 0.5 s; bystander ≤ 1.5 m covering ≥ 25 %; sun < 6°; < 75 % framed; readability 0.6) are chosen, not measured against footage. Occlusion and readability use the planner's prisms and per-tick people / part boxes, not the render mesh; the render comparison (verifyCamera over directed tracks) runs only in Playwright, not in this report. Fixtures are synthetic yards; the only real takes exercised are the flagship and the 2024 kitchen route. Readability of the year-build takes stays low (bay 1 min 0.42, whole house 0.31) — the planner's 0.5 Hz slow shots accept it.
